full_llm_interaction_log.purpose: Running a mass replacement script to fix the AI model name across all files
full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: I have 10 JSON files and the model name in all of them needs to be changed from 'GPT-5.2' to 'Claude Sonnet 4.6'. What is the safest Python script to do this without corrupting the JSON?
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: Recommended using json.load + in-memory dict modification + json.dump rather than string replacement, to avoid accidentally changing nested values or breaking structure.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: Ran the script and validated all 10 files with json.load() to confirm they parse correctly after modification.

full_llm_interaction_log.purpose: Removing unicode em-dash characters from the metadata fields
full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: Some of my JSON task fields contain the character — (em-dash, unicode U+2014). This was causing issues when another script tried to parse the file. How do I clean this out of all 10 files at once?
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: Provided a one-liner using content.replace('\u2014', '-') in a file-reading loop. Simple and safe for this case.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: After running the replacement, all 10 files were re-validated with json.load() and no encoding errors appeared.
